definitions.gloss: assassin; person who carries out an assassination
definitions.explanation: A person who kills a prominent figure, especially for political or ideological reasons.

examples.japanese: {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{正体|しょうたい}→正体：13190_shoutai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になっていない。
examples.english: The identity of the assassin has not yet been revealed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史上|れきしじょう}→歴史上：24044_rekishijou⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{指導者|しどうしゃ}→指導者：03062_shidousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧きた。
examples.english: Throughout history, many leaders have fallen at the hands of assassins.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in news, history, and fiction. The base word ⟦{暗殺|あんさつ}→暗殺：10142_ansatsu⟧ means "assassination," and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ is the suffix for "person."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{雇|やと}う→雇う：02320_yatou⟧ (to hire an assassin)
- {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (to fall at the hands of an assassin)
- {暗殺者|あんさつしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧ (to arrest an assassin)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刺客|しかく}: assassin — more literary, often used in historical contexts
- ⟦{殺|ころ}し{屋|や}→殺し屋：21665_koroshiya⟧: hitman, hired killer — informal, broader meaning
